messages:
Marco: FYI ran the new prompt sampling weights during quant4b onboarding and our nightly benchmark flagged a drop in long-context F1 for the 'edge-instruction' slice. not catastrophic but consistent in int4.
Asha: Can you paste the exact sampling diff? did we accidentally double-count some paraphrase groups?
Marco: snippet below. we moved edge-instruction from 0.03 -> 0.18 to stress long-reasoning.
```
sampling:
  default: 0.79
  edge-instruction: 0.18  # was 0.03
  misc: 0.03
```
Talia: Did the holdout/golden set change at the same time? even a small overlap can bias the eval.
Marco: no golden changes. only live sampler touched yesterday at 01:12 UTC. infra-bot shows deploy id 7a2d1.
infra-bot: deploy | user: marco | id: 7a2d1 | service: onboarding-sampler | ts: 2026-03-22T01:12:05Z
Dmitri: ok i'll run a two-arm replay (fp16 vs int4) on a seeded subset of edge-instruction. Dmitri: command: `./bin/replay --cohort edge-instruction --ids 2026-03-22 --models fp16,int4 --out replay_4332.csv`
labeling-bot: nightly-eval | model: quant4b-int4 | metric: long_context_f1 | baseline: 0.725 -> new: 0.684 | delta: -0.041 | slice: edge-instruction
Sophie: capacity: we can spin a micro-golden of 400 examples, 2 labelers + 1 adjudicator. estimate 2.5 hours. tagging @Talia to coordinate.
Talia: I can start MK-1120 micro-golden and set priority high. ETA to complete labeling 3 hours.
Asha: Also add a quick sanity checklist before we blame quant: tokenization versions, tokenizer-regens, kv-cache prefix length, prompt-truncation, and any prompt-template changes. small infra deltas often amplify in int4.
Dmitri: replay started. will attach per-example mismatches. plan to run logit-topk diffs for the examples that flip.
Marco: If replay reproduces drop in int4 only, hold rollout for int4 variant. if both show drop, revert sampling.
Sophie: labeling started on MK-1120. marking obvious duplicates for early consensus to speed adjudication.
Dmitri: early replay: int4 delta -0.046, fp16 delta -0.009. attaching quick summary to artifacts. looks like quant amplification on paraphrase-heavy prompts.
Asha: interesting. paraphrase density up from sampling will hit metrics if our scoring is brittle to wording. Sophie, mark cases where gold and candidate are semantically same but token-different.
Sophie: doing that. ~30% of sample batch flagged as paraphrase-equivalent; pushing to adjudicator.
labeling-bot: micro-golden-created | id: MK-1120 | cohort: edge-instruction | size: 400 | due: 2026-03-22T15:00:00Z
Marco: Good. Dmitri, can you run a quick per-token logit variance probe and a top-k intersection test between fp16 and int4 for flipped examples?
Dmitri: yes. running per-token variance + topk. will post results in ~2h.
Talia: labeling complete. adjudications required: 36/400. moving adjudicated CSV to infra artifacts.
Dmitri: top-k intersection drops significantly on long prefixes for int4; per-token variance higher at the tail tokens. hypothesis: quant rounding coupled with longer kv cache/prefix lengths amplifies small differences leading to different final outputs.
Asha: let's add two onboarding steps ASAP: 1) quant-sensitivity check (fp16 vs int4 per-cohort diff) and 2) sampling-change canary (replay before and after sampling flips). put as required gates for dedicated rollout.
Marco: I'll open a GH issue with artifacts: replay CSV, topk diffs, adjudicated gold. tagging @Dmitri @Sophie @Talia.
infra-bot: issue created | repo: onboarding | number: 412 | title: quant-sensitivity + sampling-canary for promptset changes | creator: marco
Jen: (jumping in) also consider adding a metric tolerant-to-paraphrase like semantic-similarity threshold in evals so we don't overcount superficial wording changes.
Sophie: agreed. many disagreements are phrasing variants not content errors. adjudicated eval with semantic scoring will be useful.
Marco: for now we will: revert sampler to previous weights, hold int4 rollout, merge semantic-tolerant eval into next nightly, and require replay results for any sampling > 5x change.
Marco: reverting sampler now.
labeling-bot: sampler-revert | user: marco | from: edge-instruction:0.18 -> 0.03 | ts: 2026-03-22T05:04:10Z
Dmitri: posting final artifacts link: s3://redwood-artifacts/onboarding/replay/4332109876_summary.csv
Sophie: thanks team. will sync adjudicated eval once Marco links the GH issue. closing thread when GH has the artifacts. :white_check_mark:
